basic_info.description: 263 Texas Street, the lower flat of a 2-unit building, is about connectivity, style, intimacy, flexibility, and living at the center of it all. The beautifully remodeled eat-in kitchen is the nexus of the home, surrounded by a versatile double-parlor and a large rebuilt east-facing deck off of the kitchen that invites indoor-outdoor living. The primary bedroom w/ensuite bath & chic jewel-box powder room cap off the main level. Below the deck is a renovated multi-purpose room outfitted w/ a murphy bed, and windows with natural light & eastern outlooks, perfect for an office or private room for guests to enjoy. Shared areas include the backyard & huge basement storage that spans the footprint of the home. Most find that Texas Street offers abundant parking, and the home is eligible for a neighborhood parking permit. This Texas and 18th Street location is in the heart of Potrero Hill. Connected to all the Hill's favorites, you also have easy accessibility to the best of Dogpatch, Crane Cove Park and the connecting waterfront, plus events at Chase Center and Oracle Park. For transit you are conveniently located near tech shuttle busses, 280 and 101 highways, Caltrain, and the Muni T-line. No other location in the city can provide that combination, and you get the best weather in SF!
